property_summary: For the reference C, any successful airDrop() call must come from a caller whose supportsToken() equals keccak256(abi.encodePacked('Nu Token')), so tokenBalance[successful caller] becomes exactly 20; the inverted mutant allows a caller whose supportsToken() returns anything other than the hash, so a helper that reports a different token hash can successfully call airDrop() and receive 20 tokens, violating the invariant.
change_summary: Inverted the supportsToken check to require inequality with the token hash.
